actual_input_passages.heading: Rule 1: For Every Result, Keep Track of How It Was Produced
actual_input_passages.text: As a minimum, you should at least record sufficient details on programs, parameters, and manual procedures to allow yourself, in a year or so, to approximately reproduce the results.

actual_input_passages.heading: Rule 2: Avoid Manual Data Manipulation Steps
actual_input_passages.text: Whenever possible, rely on the execution of programs instead of manual procedures to modify data. Such manual procedures are not only inefficient and error-prone, they are also difficult to reproduce. If working at the UNIX command line, manual modification of files can usually be replaced by the use of standard UNIX commands or small custom scripts. If working with integrated frameworks, there will typically be a quite rich collection of components for data manipulation. If manual operations cannot be avoided, you should as a minimum note down which data files were modified or moved, and for what purpose.
